content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is a technical institute in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. This position is advertised by its Research & Development Office for the project "Center for Creative Learning." The project is run by the institute's Center for Creative Learning department, and Prof Manish Jain is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II (Chemistry) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility follows Institute norms, not funding agency norms. M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Tech./B.E. in a Chemistry-related engineering/technical field, with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience, OR B.Sc. with Chemistry as a subject, with at least 06 years of post-qualification experience. Marks: at least 60% or an equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and at least 55% or an equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th. The institute wants a self-driven, creative chemistry educator with a strong interest in school STEM education through hands-on and inquiry-based learning. The following are preferred but not required: Experience teaching chemistry to students in grades 8-12 (for example as a TGT or PGT, or under CBSE, IB, IGCSE, ICSE and state boards). Good communication and facilitation skills, professional fluency in spoken and written English and in spoken Hindi, and good digital documentation skills. Experience designing and conducting physical experiments and hands-on activities, and using lab instruments. 1 year of experience writing textbook chapters or making learning modules for grades 8-12 in ed-tech. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Creating high-quality, rigorous hands-on chemistry modules for grades 6-12, and updating and organising the resource repository. Adapting, making, testing and optimising activities, models and prototypes. Documenting the work as manuals, chapters, worksheets, presentations, videos and articles. Turning suitable activities into models that schools can use, with product specifications. Coordinating and running the testing of content in schools.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cut-off may be used. The institute may choose not to call an applicant for a selection test. It may also decide not to fill the position in this round, without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply with a B.Sc. alone?
faq.answer: Yes, if Chemistry was one of your subjects and you have at least 06 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience do M.Sc. or B.Tech. holders need?
faq.answer: Candidates with an M.Sc. in Chemistry or a B.Tech./B.E. in a Chemistry-related field need at least 02 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What marks are required?
faq.answer: You need at least 60% or an equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or an equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q4. Is school teaching experience required?
faq.answer: No. Teaching chemistry to grades 8-12, for example as a TGT or PGT, is listed only as a desirable background.

faq.question: Q5. Which project is this post under?
faq.answer: The post is under the Center for Creative Learning project at IIT Gandhinagar, and Prof Manish Jain is the Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q6. Is house rent allowance paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice lists HRA as "NA," so the pay is the consolidated monthly amount only.

faq.question: Q7. What will the selected candidate do?
faq.answer: They will create hands-on chemistry modules for grades 6-12, document them as manuals, worksheets and videos, and coordinate testing of the content in schools.

faq.question: Q8. Which languages are preferred?
faq.answer: Professional fluency in spoken and written English and in spoken Hindi is listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact with questions?
faq.answer: Write to Prof Manish Jain at [email protected].
